name: Bare Hands
description: Your trusty fingers. Not very effective, but better than nothing.

name: Fishing Rod
description: A basic rod for catching small fish. Reliable and easy to use.
note: Slightly increased catch rate for common fish.

name: Harpoon
description: Used for spearing larger fish. Requires skill and timing.
note: Higher chance to catch rare fish. May miss small ones.

name: Fishing Net
description: Catches multiple fish at once. Great for bulk fishing.
note: Can catch 2–3 fish per cast. Lower chance for rare fish.

name: Dynamite
description: Explosive fishing. Risky but effective. May scare off NPCs.
note: High chance for rare fish. May reduce NPC mood.

name: Fishing Bow
description: A ranged tool for precision fishing. Stylish and silent.
note: Increased chance for epic and mythic fish. Silent cast.

name: Magnet Fishing Rope
description: Used to pull metallic treasures from the water. Not for fish.
note: Can retrieve coins, gear, and rare loot. No fish caught.
